zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增桌面歌词，支持字重、阴影强度、描边宽度等设置，窗口位置自动记忆
• 新增 LRC Enhanced 歌词格式支持
• 新增艺术家拆分显示，可显示多位艺人
• 动画歌词支持逐字渲染与字重动画
• 设置页重构，按类别拆分为多个子页面
• 新增 AM 风格着色器，旋转网格着色器性能优化（SIMD 加速）
en:
Release Notes
• Added desktop lyrics with weight, shadow intensity and stroke width settings; window position is remembered
• Added LRC Enhanced lyrics format support
• Added split-artist display for tracks with multiple artists
• Animated lyrics now support per-word rendering and font-weight animation
• Settings page refactored into categorized sub-pages
• Added AM-style shader; rotating mesh shader optimized with SIMD
